status: PROVISIONAL (Voice bot, 2026-10-18). feat/scene-audio-r1 did not exist on GitHub when this was written; the cloud task should map these rows onto its real config format. Values (paths, loop facts, volumes, fades, intervals) are the design source of truth; key names are not.

conventions.path: path inside the bundle, no extension
conventions.vol: AudioSource.volume at the default music slider (0.4). Multiply by ambienceBedGain(slider) like AmbienceAudio/LakeAmbience do today; BGM keeps using GameAudio musicVolume
conventions.loopS: circular loop period in seconds. Every new loop file carries a 0.15 s duplicate of its own start after loopS (dupS), same as amb_lake_loop: start the second source at loopS - 0.15 and cross linearly (identical audio) for 0.15 s, or use platform loop as a fallback
conventions.intervalS: random one-shot spacing [min, max] seconds, measured start to start
conventions.followRoomLight: true = scale by (1 - WorldFlow.getRoomLightWeight()) like the current sea waves (silent indoors)
conventions.fadeInS / fadeOutS: layer fades when the scene is entered / left (equal-power)
conventions.bgmHandover: shape 'dip': old track fades out over the first 4 s of xfadeS, new track fades in over the last 4 s (2 s overlap). Used where keys differ (island F major -> meadow G major -> sky D minor) so the two keys barely overlap; the ambience bed carries the gap

home.notes: Indoors the room-light weight is 1, so the sea is silent, exactly as today. No gulls, no wind indoors.

fallback.why: shipped synthetic waves (resources) if the island bundle is not loaded yet

layers.notes: unchanged gull v6 system (AmbienceAudio); only the scene gate is new: gulls ONLY in home-outdoor/island/the first 10 s of the sail
far gulls only while the island is still in view; none on open sea

sea.notes: Sail leg <= 30.5 s (sail-qa4 timing.json). Island shore fades out 0-8 s after departure; meadow layers fade in over the last 6 s (docking). Boat SFX (leave shore / waves / sail / dock) are the separate r5 sail-audio task, not this table.

layers.notes: reuses the shipped soft-wind loop (resources, 12 KB); loop it the way WindAudio already does
ideally once per sail-blade revolution of windmill_sails_loop, skipped randomly so it never sounds mechanical
shipped LakeAmbience file and numbers, unchanged

lakeside.notes: No dedicated lakeside BGM exists. Island BGM 3 dB softer under the lake bed. A lakeside track is a decision for Funning.

bridge.notes: island -> lakeside rainbow-bridge walk: island shore fades out from walk start over 12 s, gulls stop at walk start, lake fades in over the arrival stretch (LakeAmbience already starts at journeyPhase 'arrival').

balloon.notes: meadow layers fade out over 10 s after take-off. If region_skycity is not loaded yet, run the balloon without the air bed (BGM only).

boards.rule: A level board keeps its region's BGM (no restart) and ambience at -6 dB (beds x0.5); one-shot intervals x2 (half as many). Region: r05-meadow-* -> meadow, r05-sky-* -> skycity, r04/r05-lake-* -> lakeside, everything else -> island.

home->island.notes: same track; shore opens with the door via room-light weight

sea->meadow.notes: BGM handover already done mid-voyage; if the voyage was skipped, crossfade 6 s on arrival

any->board.notes: keep the region track; beds to x0.5 over 1.5 s

skycity->island / any->home.notes: returning home: 3 s crossfade, all region layers fade 3 s, gulls resume after 4 s
